Weekly Signal — September 7–13, 2026

1 new archive item, 3 active builds, and a clean-room rebuild of LUMON MDR / Severance Refiner.

New in the archive

The latest publication date gathers 1 article.

  • Text Me Once: Notification-Agent Design Rules I Learned from a Nine-Day Spam Storm
    A watcher agent that texted my phone every 15 minutes for nine days about three hosts that were, it turns out, back online the whole time. A five-times-a-day Hacker News scout that has never once repeated itself. The difference between them is the whole lesson.

Active builds

  • rapp-train — RAPP release-train flight deck — join or test-fly any ring from one page
  • rapp-workspace-manager — Private, local-first pointer manager for Git and RAPP workspaces
  • rapp-beta — RAPP release-train beta ring; seeded from the untouched Grail

Rediscovered

The Frame That Writes Itself — By the time the model actually starts predicting the next token, 90% of the authorship has already happened.

Lost App → clean-room lesson

LUMON MDR / Severance Refiner: A mysterious retro-corporate number game rebuilt as an original deterministic state-machine challenge.

Open the rebuild lesson · Run the local demo

RAPP Vision brief

The strangest lost app asks you to identify numbers that simply feel wrong.

Reverse-engineering a mysterious selection mechanic into a deterministic state-machine game.

Short: Which of these numbers looks wrong?
